NotificationKind.description: The kind of a [`WorkerNotification`]. Only [`Self::RunCompleted`] exists today; modeled as an enum (rather than a bare string) so it is part of the generated contract and the console can switch on it as more are added.

oneOf.description: A run reached a terminal state (produced a record, or failed before one).

NotificationOutcome.description: Whether a finished run produced a record. Mirrors the console's run outcome: `completed` carries a record id to open; `failed` carries a reason.

oneOf.description: The run produced a record (its own `status.state` may still be a failure).
The run could not be driven to a record at all.

description:
A worker-wide notification that a run reached a terminal state.

Carries the run's display identity (flattened, so the JSON matches the console's `InProgressRun`/notification shape) plus how it ended: a `completed` run includes the `recordId` to open; a `failed` run includes the `message`.

harnessSlug.description: The harness driving the run, as its slug string.

jobId.description: The live stream/job id the run was observed under.

kind.description: The notification kind. Only `run-completed` exists today; carried explicitly so the console can switch on it as more are added.

message.description: A human-readable failure reason, present when `outcome` is `failed`.

modelId.description: The opaque model id passed to the harness.

recordId.description: The persisted run record's id — what the console links the alert to. For a `completed` run this is the produced record's own id; for a `failed` run it is the job id, which is also the id the failed record is persisted under (see [`crate::runner::drive_run`]), so a failure alert still opens the run.
